purpose: Teach: 送別/追従/面識/外形/技巧/乗組/パネリスト/不買

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員の送別会も自ら企画された
lines.en: You know, when Dad was founding the company, he personally organized the farewell parties for the early staff.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. Gentle weight on the memory. Speaking as though painting a portrait with words. Slight pause before continuing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは流行への追従を嫌われた
lines.en: Yes. He had a real distaste for following trends. He insisted on doing things his own way.
lines.style: Steady, affirmative tone. Quiet conviction in the voice — not defensive, just factual. Respectful acknowledgment of the principle being named.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、初対面の方にも面識ある如く接された
lines.en: Even with people he was meeting for the first time, he'd treat them like old friends.
lines.style: Warm and almost wistful. Voice carries a gentle smile. Speaking from genuine memory, not for effect. Soft landing on the observation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の外形にもこだわった
lines.en: Yes. He was meticulous about the details — even the appearance of the product itself mattered deeply to him.
lines.style: Calm, measured reflection. Slight emphasis on the detail-oriented nature — not pedantic, but sincere. Pause weight in the middle of the thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、職人の技巧を尊重されていた
lines.en: He truly respected the skill of the craftspeople who made things. He valued that artistry.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tender in tone. Speaking with the clarity of someone who witnessed something rare. Breath carries weight of admiration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商船の乗組員にも挨拶された
lines.en: Yes. He'd greet even the crew of the merchant ships. No one was beneath his notice.
lines.style: Quiet factual delivery. Understated pride in the principle — not boasting, observing. Voice carries the weight of witnessing humility in action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界シンポのパネリストとして登壇された
lines.en: He was invited to speak as a panelist at industry symposiums — he was that respected.
lines.style: Measured, matter-of-fact. The achievement sits in the statement without fanfare. Slight uplift in confidence as the weight of his father's standing becomes clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは不買運動に丁寧に向き合われた
lines.en: Yes. And even when there was a boycott movement against us, he faced it with care and respect, not defensiveness.
lines.style: Composed, grounded final statement. Gentle firmness — not hardness. Voice carries the weight of principle meeting difficulty. Closing breath is settled, honoring the legacy.
